facts.fact: Techies reports the NIP, a unique identifier for each citizen, began to be attributed on 3 April 2024 in Libreville, and issuing of the electronic national identity card (CNIE) began on 24 June 2024.

GAB.note: NIP attribution was reported suspended for several months in 2026, which no value of this study records.
